sum: GVP Infotech Limited has published a newspaper advertisement announcing the First and Final Call Money Notice for its rights issue. The notice was filed with NSE on 1 July 2026, indicating an active capital raise via rights offering to existing shareholders.
detail: GVP Infotech Limited filed a newspaper advertisement with the NSE regarding the First and Final Call Money Notice for its rights issue. This notice signals the final stage of rights subscription and sets the deadline for shareholders to remit call money. The company had previously disclosed the rights offer via exchange filings and prospectus circulation. First call notices typically provide a 10–14 day window and are followed by allotment and refund mechanics under the listing agreement and SEBI guidelines.
